evidence: The PE-ALD TaN x thin ﬁlm was deposited at 300°C on the 300 nm thick thermal SiO 2 thin ﬁlm using TaCl 5 and the gas mixture of H2 /N2 as the tantalum precursor and reducing reactant, respectively. The thickness of the PE-ALD TaN x thin ﬁlm was controlled by optimizing the number of ALD process cycles. One cycle of the PE-ALD TaN x deposition process consisted of four consecutive pulses, including a TaCl 5 precursor injection pulse, an Ar purge pulse with a ﬂow rate of 50 sccm, a H 2 /N2 plasma nitridation pulse, and another Ar purge pulse.
